title: Own-Motion Investigation Karamu: A report of an own-motion investigation into the management of the alleged misuse of force against prisoners at the Risdon Prison Complex, Mary Hutchinson Women’s Prison and Hobart Reception Centre between 1 July and 31 December 2023

sentences.text: Tasmania’s Integrity Commission investigated how prison authorities managed alleged or recorded inappropriate force against prisoners and detainees between July and December 2023.

cites.document: Report of the Integrity Commission No. 1 of 2025

sentences.text: It examined use-of-force rules, training, incident reporting, internal reviews and external oversight, without making findings about individual misconduct.

cites.document: Report of the Integrity Commission No. 1 of 2025

sentences.text: The Commission found that officers generally followed standard practices, but identified excessive force, incomplete incident reports and inconsistent or outdated guidance.

cites.document: Report of the Integrity Commission No. 1 of 2025

sentences.text: It concluded that the Prison Service needed to replace informal responses to excessive force with appropriate formal processes.

cites.document: Report of the Integrity Commission No. 1 of 2025

sentences.text: Its ninety-two numbered recommendations addressed accountability, policies, reporting, training and independent oversight.
